column1: # Kenshi addresses used by AnarchyKenshi.dll v0.133.1 (SHA-256 c3d2419d...51bb), decoded from its two site tables.
# RVAs into kenshi_x64.exe. steam_rva checked by pattern against Steam kenshi_x64.exe SHA-256 a596ab4e...aeb1 (all rows match). gog_rva not checked (no GOG exe).

# table A: AnarchyKenshi.dll RVA 0xec4570, 48-byte rows. table B: RVA 0xece680, 80-byte rows. kind: code = address of a function or code site; ref = address read from a RIP-relative operand of the instruction at steam_anchor (mostly globals; Global_* rows carry the address directly).

# detoured: yes = an inline hook (own E9-jump engine) is installed on it by the listed installer function(s) in AnarchyKenshi.dll (from the decompile, see hooks.md); no = only called or read. yes is an upper bound: it includes hooks installed only in server mode or behind feature switches. Gate patches and AiTick hooks are counted in hooks.md, not here.
